svg.text: Interface connector (one per signal group; arrow = active to passive)

The top module is structural. AXI4 and HyperBus share CLK-CORE; APB4 is asynchronous on CLK-APB. DQ/RWDS cross the top boundary as separate input, output, and active-high OE signals; the SoC pad wrapper creates the physical bidirectional buses. APB-only reset requires an idle APB bus and no CDC request or response pending and preserves core and memory state.
One structural top with APB4 CSR, AXI4, HyperBus control and PHY children.
